profile_text.body:
Vercel is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company operates v0.dev, a platform it describes as a collaborative AI assistant for designing, iterating, and scaling full-stack web applications.

Its primary AI product, v0, falls in the coding and developer tools category and focuses on UI generation, allowing users to build full-stack web apps through an AI-assisted interface.

The held facts note 161 legal exposure entries associated with California, and Vercel maintains two MCP servers in the registry: one that scans websites or MCP servers for agent readiness and returns a scored report with suggested fixes, and another that handles SVG metadata search and licensed commercial SVG exports for coding agents.
